description: Centre of the game header under the Modern UI theme on a freshly started save. Four lines are rendered: 'You have 10.0 antimatter.', 'You are getting 0 antimatter per second.', 'AD Tickspeed: 1.000 / sec' and '×1.125 faster per upgrade'.

The same region of the game header under the Classic UI theme, on the same freshly started save. Only 'You have 10.0 antimatter.' and 'You are getting 0 antimatter per second.' are rendered; the space below them is blank.
